items.title: Deploy Build 240 and verify the Inventory Posting page
items.action_path: Deploy preview, hard-refresh /admin-inventory-posting, verify CSS/scripts/menu/route copy and confirm no console error.

items.title: Apply the Build 240 transaction migration in staging
items.action_path: Run the complete Build 240 migration after prior migrations, refresh schema cache, and confirm tables/RPCs.

items.title: Complete booking inventory posting acceptance
items.action_path: Preview and commit a small booking usage batch; verify stock, movement, batch, row and job history evidence.

items.title: Complete Creative Project reservation posting acceptance
items.action_path: Post reviewed project reservations and verify project ownership, shortage checks, status and inventory_mutated evidence.

items.title: Complete idempotency, shortage and rollback tests
items.action_path: Replay the same key, submit an over-stock request, and confirm no duplicate or partial mutations.

items.title: Complete authorized reversal and accounting review
items.action_path: Preview/commit a compensating reversal and reconcile booking COGS journal evidence without deleting history.

items.title: Retest Block Calendar full-day, AM and PM behaviour
items.action_path: Create/remove each block type and confirm public booking availability matches after refresh.

items.title: Complete end-to-end booking, payment and notification test
items.action_path: Run phone-sized booking, deposit, webhook, email and admin reconciliation with safe evidence.

items.title: Complete Cloudflare and Supabase recovery rehearsal
items.action_path: Audit variables/bindings then perform staging restore and deployment rollback with smoke tests.

items.title: Complete legal, consent and staff permission review
items.action_path: Publish policies, verify links, roles, session expiry and private media/incident boundaries.

items.title: Complete real-device mobile and accessibility acceptance
items.action_path: Test customer/admin paths, keyboard, focus, labels, contrast, wrapping, tables and touch targets.

items.title: Finish resumable media upload and derivative worker
items.action_path: Implement resumable weak-network upload recovery, deduplication and WebP/AVIF responsive derivatives.

items.title: Add automatic product publish-readiness gates
items.action_path: Block public publishing when required image roles, price, tax, category, stock, SEO or consent are incomplete.

items.title: Complete inventory name/category/cost/duplicate cleanup
items.action_path: Use suspicious-name, transactional bulk update, merge preview and audit history tools.

items.title: Complete sellable product galleries and pricing review
items.action_path: Finish featured plus seven images, alt/captions/roles, costs, HST, margins and public display.

items.title: Complete payment application and tax workflow
items.action_path: Post approved receipts against AR, add HST review, exceptions and traceable journal links.

items.title: Add month-end close, lock/reopen and accountant export
items.action_path: Implement controlled period close, authorized reopen and evidence-complete export packaging.

items.title: Complete Search Console, schema and GBP alignment
items.action_path: Submit sitemap, validate canonicals/schema/indexing and align GBP services, areas, hours, photos and reviews.

items.title: Replace high-value placeholders with approved local proof
items.action_path: Prioritize homepage, town/service pages, booking, galleries and trust blocks using customer-approved Rosie-owned images.

items.title: Run invite-only soft launch and prioritize observed failures
items.action_path: Accept a small known-customer cohort and review every booking, payment, notification, upload, inventory and incident event daily.
